fixed: The camera spent three to five seconds in plain blue on its way through the water; the flights between places are shorter and the dive is filled with bubbles and slanting light.
The Earth and the seal arrived only at the end of their lines; the camera now gets there first and holds while the line is said.
Zooming into the spleen passed through plain purple and once through bare skin; its sponge of pores and red cells now carries all the way in, with the body kept open.
The water's tint washed out the lungs, heart and spleen; the inside is drawn over the water now.
The question at the top was white on the light wall and small for a wide picture; it is dark and half as big again.
The figure read as a capsule; it has a chest, an arm, legs and a foot, and its hair only at the back of the head.
The backup tank's outline came out dotted and too late; it is solid and draws in on the word.
notes: One journey: you under the bathwater with the counter ticking, down through the water to the turning Earth, back to the counter (1 MIN), into your chest, the lungs and the beating heart, the blood leaving the hands and feet, into the spleen's sponge of red cells, the cells pouring out like a backup tank, and through the water to a seal with its spleen glowing. Measured: never empty for more than 0.4 s, never still.
